mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebay_performance_ranking ( stat_month, principal_name, gross_profit, sales_amount, refund_amount, net_sales_amount, create_time, update_time ) SELECT p.stat_month, CASE WHEN p.brand_code IN ('FLL', 'LEJ') THEN '方黎力' WHEN p.brand_code = 'CL' THEN '陈丽' ELSE COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(r.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(r.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) END AS principal_name, SUM(COALESCE(p.gross_profit, 0)) AS gross_profit, SUM(COALESCE(p.sales_amount, 0)) AS sales_amount, SUM(COALESCE(p.refund_amount, 0)) AS refund_amount, SUM(COALESCE(p.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.refund_amount, 0)) AS net_sales_amount, NOW(), NOW() FROM ebay_monthly_performance_profit p LEFT JOIN ebay_performance_owner_rule r ON r.stat_month = p.stat_month AND r.brand_code = p.brand_code WHERE p.stat_month = #{statMonth} GROUP BY p.stat_month, CASE WHEN p.brand_code IN ('FLL', 'LEJ') THEN '方黎力' WHEN p.brand_code = 'CL' THEN '陈丽' ELSE COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(r.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(r.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_monthly_performance_profit p LEFT JOIN ebay_performance_owner_rule r ON r.stat_month = p.stat_month AND r.brand_code = p.brand_code WHERE p.stat_month = #{statMonth} AND p.brand_code NOT IN ('FLL', 'LEJ', 'CL') AND ( r.id IS NULL OR TRIM(r.principal_name) = '' OR TRIM(r.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') )

SELECT id AS id, stat_month AS statMonth, principal_name AS principalNames, gross_profit AS grossProfit, net_sales_amount AS netSalesAmount, update_time AS updateTime FROM ebay_performance_ranking WHERE stat_month =
#{statMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.stat_month) FROM ebay_performance_ranking x)
AND principal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{principalName}, '%')
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, net_sales_amount DESC, id
